dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「え、バレちゃった？」
dialogues.en:
We nearly hit each other, but Miharu stopped right before my
eyes.
dialogues.text:
We nearly hit each other, but Miharu stopped right before my
eyes.

dialogues.jp: 朝のＨＲの後、俺は暦先生にそう報告した。
dialogues.en: "You found what?"
dialogues.text: "You found what?"

dialogues.jp:
最初は呆気にとられていたけど、しばらくして
暦先生は崩れ落ちるようなため息を吐いた。
dialogues.en:
"Oh? Okay, but we can't talk about it here. Let's go to the
biology preparation room."
dialogues.text:
"Oh? Okay, but we can't talk about it here. Let's go to the
biology preparation room."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「も〜、しっかりしてよ〜。とにかくここじゃ
　なんだから、準備室に来て」
dialogues.en: I pulled her by the hand to the room.
dialogues.text: I pulled her by the hand to the room.

dialogues.jp: そう言って、俺の袖をぐいと引っ張る。
dialogues.en:
Like yesterday, I start to make some coffee here. Today I'll
put some milk in it.
dialogues.text:
Like yesterday, I start to make some coffee here. Today I'll
put some milk in it.

dialogues.jp: 「あの、授業は？」
dialogues.en: But I won't say anything bad about Koyomi-sensei any more.
dialogues.text: But I won't say anything bad about Koyomi-sensei any more.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「大丈夫、事情を聞くだけだから問題ない。５
　分で終わる」
dialogues.en: "Listen. I had a dream last night."
dialogues.text: "Listen. I had a dream last night."

dialogues.jp:
準備室で俺は、昨日あった出来事をつぶさに語っ
た。
dialogues.en: "A dream? Can robots have dreams?"
dialogues.text: "A dream? Can robots have dreams?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「――ま、朝倉妹にバレただけなら、まだ大丈
　夫だろう」
dialogues.en: "I thought I couldn't, but I did!"
dialogues.text: "I thought I couldn't, but I did!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「一応、本人は誰にも言わないって言ってまし
　たけど」
dialogues.en:
It was hard to believe. But maybe she was so well-made that
she can even dream in her sleep.
dialogues.text:
It was hard to believe. But maybe she was so well-made that
she can even dream in her sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「それにしても、ねじ穴が背中じゃダメか……。
　そうだよね、人前で巻けないもんね」
dialogues.en:
"It was a dream of my childhood. I was playing with you and
Nyamu-sempai."
dialogues.text:
"It was a dream of my childhood. I was playing with you and
Nyamu-sempai."

dialogues.jp:
先生は、カタカタとパソコンのキーボードを叩
きながら俺の方を見る。
dialogues.en: Uh...
dialogues.text: Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「とにかく、今後は気をつけてね。こういう言
　い方はあまり好きじゃないけど――あの子は
　最重要機密なんだから」
dialogues.en:
"That means I do have some of Miharu Amakase-san's
memories."
dialogues.text:
"That means I do have some of Miharu Amakase-san's
memories."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「スミマセン……」
dialogues.en:
"Something Miharu-san has that I don't have. That's her
memories."
dialogues.text:
"Something Miharu-san has that I don't have. That's her
memories."

dialogues.jp:
まあ、正直そんなに簡単に美春の正体はバレな
いと思う。それくらい、人間とほとんど変わら
ないのだから。
dialogues.en:
"I'm still a teenager with not much experience of life, you
know?"
dialogues.text:
"I'm still a teenager with not much experience of life, you
know?"

dialogues.jp:
知らない人間は、ロボットどころか本物の美春
だと思いこんでいる。
dialogues.en:
"Wait! Koyomi-sensei said you didn't have a human-like
memory."
dialogues.text:
"Wait! Koyomi-sensei said you didn't have a human-like
memory."

dialogues.jp:
彼女の友達だって、まるで気にしていないみた
いだし。
dialogues.en: Miharu was so excited that she got a bit too close to me.
dialogues.text: Miharu was so excited that she got a bit too close to me.

dialogues.jp: ようやく休み時間になった。
dialogues.en: "Okay, okay! Stay back a bit."
dialogues.text: "Okay, okay! Stay back a bit."

dialogues.jp:
最近は美春に付きっきりなので、めっきり友達
づきあいが減ったような気がする。
dialogues.en: Then Miharu sat in the chair.
dialogues.text: Then Miharu sat in the chair.

dialogues.jp:
今じゃ、休み時間に、俺に話しかけてくるのは
杉並か眞子ぐらいのもんだ。
dialogues.en: "Certainly, what you're missing could be her memories."
dialogues.text: "Certainly, what you're missing could be her memories."

dialogues.jp:
まあ、美春と一緒にいる時間が長いほど楽しい
ので、それはそれで悪くない。
dialogues.en: Next moment, the door opened.
dialogues.text: Next moment, the door opened.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん、何を笑っているんですか？　思い出
　し笑いをするのは、なんとやらって言います
　よ？」
dialogues.en: "What's up, guys?"
dialogues.text: "What's up, guys?"

dialogues.jp:
不意に背後からの声に振り向くと、すました顔
の音夢が立っていた。
dialogues.en: "Koyomi-sensei!"
dialogues.text: "Koyomi-sensei!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そうだ。できれば今日、帰りにトイレッ
　トペーパーを買ってきてもらえます？　もう
　少しで切れそうなの」
dialogues.en:
"I could even hear your voices out in the hallway. What
happened?"
dialogues.text:
"I could even hear your voices out in the hallway. What
happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「お前が買って帰ればいいじゃないか。どうせ、
　帰ってもテレビを観るだけだろ？」
dialogues.en: "Listen. I had a dream last night."
dialogues.text: "Listen. I had a dream last night."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「それはそうですけど……、どうせならテレビ
　の時間に間に合うように帰りたいじゃないで
　すか」
dialogues.en: "A dream?"
dialogues.text: "A dream?"

dialogues.jp:
……うーむ、わが妹ながらなんて勝手なことを。
俺は、美春を送り届けるので精一杯だというの
に……。
dialogues.en:
Taking off her glasses, Koyomi-sensei looks at Miharu
somewhat suspiciously.
dialogues.text:
Taking off her glasses, Koyomi-sensei looks at Miharu
somewhat suspiciously.

dialogues.jp: ま、そう言っても聞かないだろうな。
dialogues.en: "Yes, a dream."
dialogues.text: "Yes, a dream."

dialogues.jp:
「だったら、公正にじゃんけんで決めようじゃ
　ないか」
dialogues.en:
"Listen, Amakase. Sorry to tell you, but you don't have the
ability to dream while sleeping. You only have the ability
to organize the data, but not to dream like we humans do."
dialogues.text:
"Listen, Amakase. Sorry to tell you, but you don't have the
ability to dream while sleeping. You only have the ability
to organize the data, but not to dream like we humans do."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そうきましたか」
dialogues.en: "But I experienced something very real in my sleep."
dialogues.text: "But I experienced something very real in my sleep."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、いくぞ。最初は――」
dialogues.en: "It sure sounds like a dream, but..."
dialogues.text: "It sure sounds like a dream, but..."

dialogues.jp:
ここは、見事なパーを出し、華麗に勝つのだ。
たとえ汚いと言われようとも、それが戦場の掟
だ。文句あっか。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei sat deep in the chair with her arms across her
chest.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei sat deep in the chair with her arms across her
chest.

dialogues.en: "I think it is a dream she had."
dialogues.text: "I think it is a dream she had."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「はい、私の勝ちですね！　兄さんの手の内は
　バレバレです」
dialogues.en: "How can you be so sure?"
dialogues.text: "How can you be so sure?"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が出していたのは、チョキだった。
dialogues.en: "Ah, just a hunch..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, just a hunch..."

dialogues.jp: 「ズルっこいぞー！」
dialogues.en:
I couldn't say that I have the power to get into someone
else's dream.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't say that I have the power to get into someone
else's dream.

dialogues.jp:
自分でネタ振っといての完敗だ。何も言い返せ
ない。
dialogues.en: It must be her dream I was in last night.
dialogues.text: It must be her dream I was in last night.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉せんぱ〜い、いますか〜？」
dialogues.en:
"I did have a dream! I was a kid playing with Asakura-sempai
and Nyamu-sempai."
dialogues.text:
"I did have a dream! I was a kid playing with Asakura-sempai
and Nyamu-sempai."

dialogues.jp: と、美春の声が聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, Koyomi-sensei stopped moving.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, Koyomi-sensei stopped moving.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、にゃむ先輩。どうも、お疲れさまです」
dialogues.en: And she cleared her throat and repositioned her glasses.
dialogues.text: And she cleared her throat and repositioned her glasses.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「え……あ、ああ。うん、お疲れさま」
dialogues.en:
"It can't happen, Amakase. You don't have any data on
memories."
dialogues.text:
"It can't happen, Amakase. You don't have any data on
memories."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「どうですか？　今日こそ放課後一緒にチョコ
　バナナを食べに行きませんか？　あ、それと
　もバナナパフェがいいですか？」
dialogues.en:
"I know it. But maybe there was some kind of error that
caused her memories to slip into my system."
dialogues.text:
"I know it. But maybe there was some kind of error that
caused her memories to slip into my system."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あの……ごめんなさい。今日は、その、友達
　と約束があって」
dialogues.en: "Amakase, sorry. But no. You were not built that way."
dialogues.text: "Amakase, sorry. But no. You were not built that way."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「友達と約束？」
dialogues.en: "But, it might've happened..."
dialogues.text: "But, it might've happened..."

dialogues.jp: 家でテレビ観るんじゃないのか？
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei lighted a cigarette. As she exhaled, an odor
of her cigarette smoke ran through the room.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei lighted a cigarette. As she exhaled, an odor
of her cigarette smoke ran through the room.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ほんと、ごめんね。じゃ――」
dialogues.en:
"I don't think that dreaming is that important to you,
Amakase. You are already really human-like."
dialogues.text:
"I don't think that dreaming is that important to you,
Amakase. You are already really human-like."

dialogues.jp:
音夢はそう言うと、まるで逃げるように駆け足
で教室を出ていった。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei put out her cigarette after puffing a few
times.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei put out her cigarette after puffing a few
times.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「今日こそは、にゃむ先輩とチョコバナナを食
　べにいけると思ったのに……」
dialogues.en: "It's not that big of a deal. Don't worry."
dialogues.text: "It's not that big of a deal. Don't worry."

dialogues.jp: がっくりと肩を落とす美春。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei turned around and switched on her computer.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei turned around and switched on her computer.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「これって、新手の放置プレイですかね？」
dialogues.en:
No, Koyomi-sensei. You don't understand. That's not what
Miharu is trying to say.
dialogues.text:
No, Koyomi-sensei. You don't understand. That's not what
Miharu is trying to say.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「知らん」
dialogues.en: "Sempai, shall we go home?"
dialogues.text: "Sempai, shall we go home?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ま、いいです。美春達だけで行きましょう」
dialogues.en: "Yeah... Let's get going."
dialogues.text: "Yeah... Let's get going."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あいつ、さっきは家に帰って、テレビを観る
　とか言ってたんだけどな……」
dialogues.en: "You two leaving? Take care."
dialogues.text: "You two leaving? Take care."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あれぇ、そうなんですか？」
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei gave us a forced smile, but she still looked
sad.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei gave us a forced smile, but she still looked
sad.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「確か、さっきはそう言ってた」
dialogues.en:
"Today I'm not gonna tell you that I want chocolate
bananas."
dialogues.text:
"Today I'm not gonna tell you that I want chocolate
bananas."

dialogues.jp:
聞き間違いじゃないよな。ついさっきの事だし。
屈辱的な敗北の後だから、覚えてる。
dialogues.en: "Let's go home then."
dialogues.text: "Let's go home then."

dialogues.jp: やっぱり――。
dialogues.en: But Miharu shakes her head.
dialogues.text: But Miharu shakes her head.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「もしかして、美春はにゃむ先輩に避けられて
　しまいました？」
dialogues.en: "Not yet."
dialogues.text: "Not yet."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「えっ、いや、そんな……音夢に限って」
dialogues.en: "No! Come on! I don't only think of bananas all the time."
dialogues.text: "No! Come on! I don't only think of bananas all the time."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春のことがバレちゃったですもんね。にゃ
　む先輩は特に美春さんと仲がよかった訳です
　から仕方ないですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Whatever Koyomi-sensei says, I think I have Miharu-san's
memories in me."
dialogues.text:
"Whatever Koyomi-sensei says, I think I have Miharu-san's
memories in me."

dialogues.jp:
俺がフォローをしようとしたのなんかそっちの
けで、美春はあっけらかんと笑っている。
dialogues.en:
I have no idea how the system works inside of her robotic
body. But there's a possibility that the real Miharu's
memory data somehow got into her system.
dialogues.text:
I have no idea how the system works inside of her robotic
body. But there's a possibility that the real Miharu's
memory data somehow got into her system.

dialogues.jp:
「美春、もしそうだとしても音夢は別に悪気が
　あるわけじゃなくて、その……お前のことを
　嫌ってるってわけでもなくてだな」
dialogues.en:
The data may not be restored as memories, but it could be
found inside somewhere.
dialogues.text:
The data may not be restored as memories, but it could be
found inside somewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩♪」
dialogues.en: "If I can get her memories, they will become my memories."
dialogues.text: "If I can get her memories, they will become my memories."

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと身体を丸めて俺の顔を覗き込みながら、
美春がにっこりと微笑む。
dialogues.en: "That's only a possibility though..."
dialogues.text: "That's only a possibility though..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春は全然気にしてませんから。にゃむ先輩
　がそう思ってしまうのは、当然ですよ」
dialogues.en: "Anyways, I want to go find my memories."
dialogues.text: "Anyways, I want to go find my memories."

dialogues.jp:
美春はくせっ毛混じりの髪の毛をかき上げなが
ら、苦笑いを浮かべた。
dialogues.en: "Find your memories?"
dialogues.text: "Find your memories?"

dialogues.jp: 確かに、意識しちゃうと難しいのかも知れない。
dialogues.en:
"That's right. This town should hold many fond memories for
'Miharu Amakase-san'. So..."
dialogues.text:
"That's right. This town should hold many fond memories for
'Miharu Amakase-san'. So..."

dialogues.jp:
今まで美春だと思って付き合ってきたヤツが、
実は違ってました、だなんて。
dialogues.en:
"I see. If I take you around the town, you might remember
something."
dialogues.text:
"I see. If I take you around the town, you might remember
something."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、先輩はＯＫですよね？　放課後のチョ
　コバナナ」
dialogues.en: "Yes! Can you help me, Asakura-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Yes! Can you help me, Asakura-sempai?"

dialogues.jp:
こいつはそれを予約するために、わざわざ俺の
教室まで出向いてきたのか。
dialogues.en: "Of course!"
dialogues.text: "Of course!"

dialogues.jp: 休み時間は短いというのに、健気なやつだな。
dialogues.en: Miharu was trying to become 'Miharu Amakase'.
dialogues.text: Miharu was trying to become 'Miharu Amakase'.

dialogues.jp:
「よし、わかった。今日は俺がおごってやるか
　ら好きなだけ食っていいぞ！」
dialogues.en:
For people who trusted her. She just wanted to live up to
her friends' hearts.
dialogues.text:
For people who trusted her. She just wanted to live up to
her friends' hearts.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「マジですか？　うわぁ、それじゃあ何本食べ
　ようかなぁ……５０本？　１００本？」
dialogues.en: "So does 'Miharu Amakase-san'."
dialogues.text: "So does 'Miharu Amakase-san'."

dialogues.jp:
ちょっと待て。それは常人と単位が違いすぎる
ぞ。ギネスにでも挑戦するつもりか。
dialogues.en: Miharu smiled. Yes, both of them do have big hearts.
dialogues.text: Miharu smiled. Yes, both of them do have big hearts.

dialogues.jp: 「前言撤回。５本までにしてくれ」
dialogues.en: I could tell how much Miharu respects her original.
dialogues.text: I could tell how much Miharu respects her original.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「先輩、カッコ悪い〜」
dialogues.en: "Yes! Let's go!!"
dialogues.text: "Yes! Let's go!!"

dialogues.jp:
美春がそう言って笑うので、俺もその場は笑っ
て誤魔化した。
dialogues.en: I slapped her hand with mine.
dialogues.text: I slapped her hand with mine.

dialogues.jp: ◆悩む音夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆After school, I headed to the biology preparation room.◆
dialogues.text: ◆After school, I headed to the biology preparation room.◆

dialogues.jp:
休み時間に美春が放課後チョコバナナを食べに
行こうと誘いに来る。
dialogues.en: "Sempai, sempai, sempaaaii!"
dialogues.text: "Sempai, sempai, sempaaaii!"

dialogues.jp:
音夢も誘われたのだが、音夢は友達と約束があ
るからと美春の誘いを断ってしまう。
dialogues.en:
I heard a familiar voice and the sound of someone running
behind me.
dialogues.text:
I heard a familiar voice and the sound of someone running
behind me.

dialogues.jp: さっきはすぐ家に帰ると言っていたのに。
dialogues.en: It was Miharu rushing straight towards me.
dialogues.text: It was Miharu rushing straight towards me.

dialogues.jp: やはり、そう簡単には割り切れないか……。
dialogues.en: "Wow!!"
dialogues.text: "Wow!!"
